=== Fold folds the item under the cursor
--- given
- a‸
  - b
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- a‸ ⊟
  - b

=== Fold on an item without children does nothing
--- given
- a‸
- b
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b

=== Unfold unfolds the item under the cursor
--- given
- a‸ ⊟
  - b
--- when command unfold
--- then consumed
- a‸
  - b

=== Unfold on an unfolded item does nothing
--- given
- a‸
  - b
--- when command unfold
--- then consumed
- a‸
  - b

=== Fold works from a notes line of the item
--- given
- a
  no‸te
  - b
--- when command fold
--- then consumed
- a ⊟
  no‸te
  - b
